September 15, 2026 at 12:00 PM Eastern


#


Bank of America Chicago Distance Series Details Ways to Secure Entry into the 2027 Chicago Marathon, Chicago 13.1 and Shamrock Shuffle


CHICAGO, Illinois


I.L.


– Today, the teams behind Chicago’s premier racing portfolio announced registration information for the events that will make up the fifth annual Bank of America Chicago Distance Series. The Distance Series connects the Bank of America Chicago Marathon, Chicago 13.1 and Shamrock Shuffle eight K


8K


Run in a unique challenge that rewards participants who finish all three events in 2027 with an exclusive medal and guaranteed entry into the fiftieth


50th


running of the Chicago Marathon in 2028. Individuals interested in participating are encouraged to get their names in early to ensure they can take part in the series. Registration for the Chicago 13.1 and Shamrock Shuffle launches today. The three-week application period for the 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon will open on Thursday, October 8, as events kickoff for the 2026 race.


*“The fifth annual Bank of America Chicago Distance Series marks an exciting moment in Chicago running history* ,” said **Carey Pinkowski** , executive race director of the Bank of America Chicago Marathon, Chicago 13.1 and Shamrock Shuffle *. “Participation and interest in the Distance Series have grown every year, which is a direct result of the running community’s dedication. We would not have achieved this milestone without the continued support of our participants, and we look forward to welcoming returning and new runners to the streets of Chicago in 2027 as we launch registration for next year’s events.”*


## 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon application


The Bank of America Chicago Marathon, a member of the Abbott World Marathon Majors and an internationally renowned event, will begin accepting applications for the forty ninth


49th


running of the event at 8 a.m. ( U S


U.S.


Central Time) on Thursday, October 8. Registration will be conducted through a non-guaranteed entry drawing and a series of guaranteed entry applications.


Interested individuals will have until 2 p.m. ( U S


U.S.


Central Time) on Thursday, October 29 to apply for either a guaranteed or non-guaranteed entry. The cost of an entry is two hundred fifty dollars


$250


for United States residents and two hundred sixty dollars


$260


for those residing outside of the United States.


## Guaranteed entry


Individuals can qualify for an entry into the 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon through several guaranteed entry opportunities:


- Time qualifiers who have met the event’s age-graded qualifying standards or qualify for the event’s High Performance Division.
- Legacy finishers who have completed the Chicago Marathon five or more times within the last 10 years.
- Registered participants who cancelled their 2026 entry.
- Charity participants who are fundraising for an official charity as part of the Bank of America Chicago Marathon Charity Program.
- Runners participating with an official tour operator as part of the Bank of America Chicago Marathon Tour Operator Program.
- Runners who completed the 2026 Bank of America Chicago Distance Series by finishing the 2026 Shamrock Shuffle eight K


8K


Run, Chicago 13.1 and Chicago Marathon.


## Non-guaranteed entry drawing


Those who do not qualify for a guaranteed entry can apply for the non-guaranteed entry drawing. The event will select names from the full pool of non-guaranteed entry applicants and notify applicants of their selection status on Tuesday, December 8.


The 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon will take place on Sunday, October 10, 2027. Additional details about the 2027 application are available at the[Chicago Marathon apply](http://www.chicagomarathon.com/apply) page.


## 2027 Bank of America Chicago 13.1 registration


The Bank of America Chicago 13.1 offers a unique experience, encouraging runners to explore the neighborhoods of Chicago’s West Side. The sixth annual half marathon will kick off on Sunday, June 6, 2027, with a course that weaves through the historic parks and boulevards of the West Side, starting and finishing in Garfield Park. Following the race, participants and community members are encouraged to celebrate at the Race Day Festival, featuring a mix of entertainment, health and wellness activities and community activations.


Registration for the 2027 event is now open. The entry fee for the 2027 event is one hundred twenty dollars


$120


.


Additional details about the 2027 event and registration information are available at the[Chicago 13.1 website](http://www.chicago131.com/) .


## 2027 Bank of America Shamrock Shuffle registration


The Bank of America Shamrock Shuffle is regarded as the official kickoff to the running season and a continuation of the city’s Saint


St.


Patrick’s Day celebrations. On Sunday, March 21, 2027, the race will treat participants to a one-of-a-kind eight K


8K


Run (4.97 miles) through Chicago’s Loop. Fitness enthusiasts not ready to tackle the eight K


8K


Run are encouraged to join The Mile event on Saturday, March 20, or the 2-Mile Walk on Sunday. All three events will start and finish in Chicago’s Grant Park.


Registration for the 2027 events is now open. Individuals who sign up for the eight K


8K


Run through Tuesday, October 20, 2026, have access to a special fifty one dollars


$51


entry fee in celebration of the Bank of America Chicago Distance Series. The entry fee will increase to fifty six dollars


$56


at 11:59 p.m. ( U S


U.S.


Central Time) on Tuesday, October 20, 2026.


Registration for the 2-Mile Walk is fifty one dollars


$51


. The entry fee for The Mile event is twenty five dollars


$25


and fifteen dollars


$15


for youth ages 8 to 12.


Additional details about the 2027 event and registration information are available at the[Shamrock Shuffle website](http://www.shamrockshuffle.com/) .


## Bank of America Chicago Marathon


In its forty ninth


49th


year on Sunday, October 10, 2027, the Bank of America Chicago Marathon will welcome thousands of participants from more than 100 countries and all 50 states, including a world-class professional athlete field, top regional and Masters runners, race veterans, debut marathoners and charity participants. The race’s iconic course takes participants through 29 vibrant neighborhoods on an architectural and cultural tour of Chicago. Annually, more than a million spectators line the streets cheering on tens of thousands of participants from the start line to the final stretch down Columbus Drive. As a result of the race’s national and international draw, the Chicago Marathon assists in raising millions of dollars for a variety of charitable causes while generating over seven hundred fifty six million dollars


$756 million


in annual economic impact to its host city. The 2027 Bank of America Chicago Marathon, a member of the Abbott World Marathon Majors, will start and finish in Grant Park beginning at 7:30 a.m. on Sunday, October 10, 2027. In advance of the race, a three-day Abbott Health & Fitness Expo will be held at McCormick Place Convention Center in 2027 on Thursday, October 7, Friday, October 8, and Saturday, October 9. For more information about the event and how to get involved, go to the[Chicago Marathon website](https://www.chicagomarathon.com/) .


## Bank of America Chicago 13.1


The sixth annual Bank of America Chicago 13.1 offers runner a unique experience, bringing a world-class half marathon to the neighborhoods of Chicago’s West Side. The 13.1-mile course weaves through the historic parks and boulevards of the West Side, starting and finishing in Garfield Park with scenic loops through Humboldt and Douglass Parks. A two-day Packet Pick-up will be held on Friday, June 4 and Saturday, June 5. The weekend celebrations will culminate with the half marathon and race day festival on Sunday, June 6, 2027. For more information about the event and how to get involved, go to the[Chicago 13.1 website](http://www.chicago131.com/) .


## Bank of America Shamrock Shuffle


Long recognized as an annual rite of spring, a celebration of Saint


St.


Patrick’s Day and the kickoff to the outdoor running season in Chicago, the forty sixth


46th


annual Bank of America Shamrock Shuffle treats participants to a scenic eight K


8K


run through downtown Chicago and a two-mile walk along Chicago’s lakefront. The eight K


8K


Run will kick off at 8:30 a.m., followed by the 2-Mile Walk at 9:30 a.m. on Sunday, March 21, 2027. Following the race participants can enjoy live music at the Post-Race Party in Grant Park. In advance of the event, the two-day Packet Pick-up will take place in Grant Park on Friday, March 19 and Saturday, March 20. In addition to attending Packet Pick-up, participants are encouraged to join The Mile on Saturday, March 20. For more information about the event and how to get involved, go to the[Shamrock Shuffle website](http://www.shamrockshuffle.com/) .
